description: [Tauri Apps Only] Monitor Tauri IPC calls between frontend and Rust backend. Requires active driver_session. Captures invoke() calls and responses. This is Tauri-specific; for browser network monitoring, use Chrome DevTools MCP.

action.description: Action to perform: start or stop IPC monitoring

appIdentifier.description: App port or bundle ID to target. Defaults to the only connected app or the default app if multiple are connected.

name: ipc_monitor
